actions.create: Create manually or from a file

visibilityHint.public: All users can see this trail. Only you can edit it.
visibilityHint.private: Only you can see this trail.
visibilityHint.group: Members of the group can see this trail. You and the group's admins can edit it.

list.empty: There are no trails yet. Create one or import one from OpenStreetMap.

validation.name: Enter a name.
validation.distance: Enter a distance in kilometres, greater than 0 and at most 10,000.
validation.gain: Enter the elevation gain as a whole number of metres, from 0 to 1,000,000.
validation.highest: Enter the highest point as a whole number of metres, from -500 to 9,000.

edit.title: Edit trail
edit.sharingCreatorOnly: Only the person who created this trail can change who sees it.
edit.measurementsInUse: Distance and elevation can no longer be changed: other people's hikes on this trail count them in their statistics.
edit.routeInUse: The route can no longer be replaced: other people's hikes on this trail count its distance and elevation in their statistics.

map.title: Map
map.label: Map of the trail {{name}}
map.unavailable: The map could not be shown on this device.

chart.title: Elevation profile
chart.summary: Over {{distance}}: starts at {{start}} and ends at {{end}}, with a lowest point of {{lowest}} and a highest point of {{highest}}.

osm.title: Import from OpenStreetMap
osm.searching: Searching OpenStreetMap. This can take up to a minute.
osm.onlyVisible: Only in the visible map area
osm.noResults: No hiking routes found. Try another name or a larger area.

routeFile.reading: Reading the route and calculating its elevation…
routeFile.mapLabel: Map of the route from the file

routeFile.heightsFromFile: Elevation: from the heights in the file.

problems.tooLarge: This file is larger than 30 MB.

problems.noRoute: This file has no track or route with at least two points.

errors.sharing_creator_only: Only the person who created this trail can change who sees it.
errors.trail_measurements_in_use: Distance and elevation can no longer be changed: other people's hikes on this trail count them in their statistics.
errors.trail_name_taken: A trail with this name already exists here, possibly archived. Choose another name.
errors.group_not_allowed: Only trails shared with a group can have a group.
errors.trail_has_no_owner: This trail's creator no longer has an account, so it must stay with the group.

errors.osm_route_not_found: This hiking route no longer exists in OpenStreetMap.

errors.invalid_bbox: The visible map area could not be used. Move the map and try again.
errors.route_too_short: The route needs at least two different points.
errors.route_too_long: This route is longer than 10,000 km.
errors.route_required: A trail's route can be replaced, but not removed.
errors.osm_route_read_only: The route of a trail imported from OpenStreetMap cannot be replaced.
errors.measurements_from_route: Distance and elevation come from the route, so they cannot also be entered.
